svg.aria-label: A request front on Postgres, with a generated key: 1. Database: seerr-db creates a role and a database on the shared postgres-18 cluster. An init container runs before Seerr starts, with the database settings from the Secret. 2. Key: The Password generator makes SEERR_API_KEY once. Seerr reads it from the Secret, and PushSecret writes it to 1Password item seerr-api. 3. Request: seerr.${SECRET_DOMAIN} on envoy-external is the request front door, and the only one the internet reaches for this app. 4. Scan: Seerr reaches Plex at plex.media.svc:32400 over the in-cluster service, with its own Plex token. The CiliumNetworkPolicy admits it by name. 5. Keep: kopiur snapshots the 2 GiB config claim to R2 each day.
